Research Engineer Graduate (Realtime Codec Optimizations-Video Codec) - 2027 Start (PhD)
San Diego, CA
Full-time
Onsite
New Grad

Start in 2027
TikTok is hiring a graduate research engineer for its Streaming Codec Team. The role focuses on researching and developing realtime video codec technologies and optimizing them for live-streaming production systems.
Marketing
Media and Entertainment
Social Media
Video
Consumer Applications
Content Creators
Content Discovery
H1B Sponsor Likely
Responsibilities
Design and develop commercial-grade realtime video codec technologies for emerging media formats, including 2D/3D video, multiview video, 360-degree video, and light field video
Research, design, and optimize encoding and decoding frameworks for realtime live-streaming scenarios, with a focus on performance, scalability, and robustness
Develop advanced video encoding and processing algorithms for heterogeneous computing platforms
Research and implement visual quality-oriented video coding and video processing algorithms to improve perceptual quality under practical bitrate and latency constraints
Prepare and maintain clear encoder/decoder interface documentation and technical specifications
Collaborate with cross-functional engineering and product teams to transfer research prototypes and technologies into production systems
Track state-of-the-art developments in video coding, processing, and related standardization efforts, and help shape the team’s long-term technical direction
Qualification
Video Compression

Required
Individuals who are completing or have recently completed a PhD degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics or a related discipline
Strong foundations in computer science, including algorithms, data structures, software design, and performance optimization
Solid understanding of modern image/video compression and processing algorithms
Excellent programming, debugging, and optimization skills in C/C++ or other relevant system-level programming languages
Strong problem-solving ability and a research-driven mindset
Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate in a multidisciplinary environment
Preferred
Research or industry experience in image/video systems such as live streaming, video conferencing, realtime communications, or offline transcoding
Deep familiarity with at least one mainstream video compression standard, such as AVS, H.264/AVC, H.265/HEVC, VVC, or AV1, including reference software and practical optimization
Experience with neural network-based image/video coding and processing methods
Familiarity with performance optimization techniques such as NEON/SIMD vectorization and multi-threaded system design
Experience working on heterogeneous platforms and hardware-aware codec optimization
Experience participating in international standardization activities related to image/video compression, file formats, or media systems
Strong publication record in leading conferences or journals in video coding, image processing, computer vision, multimedia, or related areas
Demonstrated potential to lead technical research directions and drive technology transfer into products
Benefits
This role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives and restricted stock units.
Employees have day one access to medical, dental, and vision insurance.
A 401(k) savings plan with company match.

Life insurance.
